title: Energy Solution Preparation for OnePot PURE Cell-Free System
author: Konstantinos Ragios
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8ayhsfw
materials: For a 2.5x Energy Solution add the materials needed tho a tube. The final concentration of the components is presented in Table 1. Before adding each component make sure it is totally melted and then vortex for a few seconds

steps.title: Check tRNA absorbance
steps.instruction: Measure the A260 absorbance of the tRNA solution before adding it to the energy mixture to ensure it has not degraded.

steps.title: Adjust final volume with water
steps.instruction: Add bi‑distilled water to the mixture until the desired final volume is reached, then vortex the solution for a few seconds.

substeps.instruction: Add bi‑distilled water up to the target volume.

steps.title: Store energy solution
steps.instruction: Aliquot or keep the completed energy solution at –80 °C until needed.
